guide.summary: A bell on a stalk that stays in one place and grabs bacteria that drift close.
guide.biology: Some real ciliates live on a stalk fixed to a surface and use a ring of beating hairs around a bell-shaped mouth to draw food toward them.
guide.rules: Lives in water, attached to mesh, beads or stone edges, and does not swim. Catches one prey within 1 cell of itself without chasing it, stores it as a meal of up to twice its own body, and waits 3 seconds before the next catch. Stops hunting when well fed. Eats Sprinter, Dusk, Recycler, Crossfeeder, Crumbsmith, Oilwick, Brothmaker, Lantern, Brinecoil, Sourbud and Sleeper; never Velvet or Rampart. Nothing in the dish eats it.
guide.example: Line a stone edge with Bellstalks, add Sprinters to the open water, and watch how far from the edge the Sprinters stay common.
